rules.clause_label: Limited license to use, copy, modify, and incorporate Examples
rules.scope_note: LucidLink grants the recipient a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license covering the Examples: use, copying, and modification, and incorporation in whole or in part into the recipient’s own applications and integrations that access or use LucidLink services. The Applicable Terms are either the linked LucidLink Terms and Conditions or a separate written agreement with LucidLink governing the recipient’s use of LucidLink services; the text does not specify which applies to a particular recipient.
rules.condition_explanation: The grant applies only while the recipient continues to comply with the Applicable Terms. Which terms apply depends on whether the recipient or its organization has entered into the described separate written agreement.
